description: Use for 'anything happening on my list?' or 'what changed at these companies this week?'. Returns findings recorded since a date (default seven days ago) for the tracked accounts, each with the event date, the date Intakra recorded it and a source link. Optional domains restrict the list. A finding can describe an older event recorded recently, and no findings is not proof of no activity. Saved records only.

domains.description: Optional company domains to check against your tracked list, up to 200. Omit to use your tracked accounts.

limit.description: Findings to return, default 50. Narrow since or domains if truncated.

since.description: Start date YYYY-MM-DD or ISO 8601 timestamp with timezone, not in the future. Default: seven days ago.

name: get_account_changes

event_date.description: When the public event happened, if known.

missing_domains.description: Requested domains that are not on the list.

title: Review changes on your account list
